Your exploratory data analysis of the team datasets go here.

```{r}
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)
library(knitr)


# 1.data

data <- st_read("eda2-folder/fullDownload.geojson", quiet = TRUE)

# Drop the map shapes so we just have a normal table
all_table <- st_drop_geometry(data)

# Keep only Atlanta
atlanta <- all_table[all_table$city == "Atlanta", ]


# 2. Dataset overview

# Number of rows and columns
nrow(atlanta)
ncol(atlanta)

# Variable names and types
names(atlanta)

variable_types <- data.frame(
  Variable = names(atlanta),
  Data_Type = sapply(atlanta, function(x) class(x)[1]),
  row.names = NULL
)
variable_types


# 3. Data quality

# Missing values
missing_values <- data.frame(
  Variable = names(atlanta),
  Missing_Count = colSums(is.na(atlanta)),
  row.names = NULL
)
missing_values$Missing_Percentage <- round(
  missing_values$Missing_Count / nrow(atlanta) * 100, 1
)
missing_values

# Duplicates
sum(duplicated(atlanta$holc_id))              # how many repeated IDs
atlanta$holc_id[duplicated(atlanta$holc_id)]  # which IDs are repeated


# 4. HOLC grade distribution

# How many areas are in each grade
table(atlanta$holc_grade)

ggplot(atlanta, aes(x = holc_grade)) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(title = "Atlanta HOLC Grade Distribution",
       x = "HOLC Grade", y = "Number of Areas")


# 5.Historical descriptions 

atlanta$description <- NA_character_

for (i in 1:nrow(atlanta)) {
  text <- atlanta$area_description_data[i]

  if (!is.na(text) && text != "") {
    info <- fromJSON(text)
    desc <- paste(unlist(info[["5"]]), collapse = " ")

    if (desc != "") {
      atlanta$description[i] <- desc
    }
  }
}

# 6. Historical neighborhood table 

keep <- c()
for (g in c("A", "B", "C", "D")) {
  idx <- which(atlanta$holc_grade == g & !is.na(atlanta$description))
  keep <- c(keep, head(idx, 3))
}


description_table <- atlanta[keep, c("holc_grade", "name", "description")]


description_table$short_description <- str_trunc(description_table$description, width = 220)


kable(
  description_table[, c("holc_grade", "name", "short_description")],
  col.names = c("HOLC Grade", "Neighborhood", "Historical Description"),
  caption = "Historical Neighborhood Descriptions by HOLC Grade"
)


# 7. Historical Description Themes


# Check whether each description mentions certain keywords (yes = 1, no = 0)
atlanta$Housing <- as.numeric(grepl("house|housing|residential|construction",
                                    atlanta$description, ignore.case = TRUE))
atlanta$Race <- as.numeric(grepl("negro|white|racial|race",
                                 atlanta$description, ignore.case = TRUE))
atlanta$Property <- as.numeric(grepl("property|value|sales",
                                     atlanta$description, ignore.case = TRUE))
atlanta$Transportation <- as.numeric(grepl("railroad|traffic|streetcar|transportation",
                                           atlanta$description, ignore.case = TRUE))


has_desc <- atlanta[!is.na(atlanta$description) &
                    atlanta$holc_grade %in% c("A", "B", "C", "D"), ]


theme_table <- aggregate(cbind(Housing, Race, Property, Transportation) ~ holc_grade,
                         data = has_desc, FUN = mean)
theme_table[, 2:5] <- round(theme_table[, 2:5] * 100, 1)
theme_table


theme_long <- data.frame(
  holc_grade = rep(theme_table$holc_grade, 4),
  Theme = rep(c("Housing", "Race", "Property", "Transportation"), each = nrow(theme_table)),
  Percentage = c(theme_table$Housing, theme_table$Race,
                 theme_table$Property, theme_table$Transportation)
)

ggplot(theme_long, aes(x = holc_grade, y = Percentage, fill = Theme)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  labs(title = "Historical Description Themes by HOLC Grade",
       x = "HOLC Grade", y = "Percentage of Descriptions (%)")
```
